items.title: Make PASS evidence envelopes total and contradiction-safe
items.context: Use the B-914f F-010/F-012 history and B-ebe4 delivery_check_set unverified+verifiedBy false PASS as concrete regressions. Define one normalized PASS predicate/envelope, reject missing/unknown/nonzero/conflicting fields, and generate field mutation plus pairwise contradiction tests. Keep CLI schema and handler/gate enforcement aligned.
items.userSees: Contradictory input prints `Blocked [delivery_promise_outcome_contradiction]: status=unverified cannot include verifiedBy; delivery-check was not written.` Valid verified/met/waived and documented legacy inputs still save and DONE readiness consumes the same normalized outcome.
excludes: Generic migration of unrelated evidence schemas
Changing review quorum or DONE assurance policy

happy.desc: A lattice-review-delivery reviewer delivery_check_set with canonical status=verified or status=met, non-empty verifiedBy, and required evidence normalizes to one PASS envelope, persists a signed delivery check, and is accepted by both lifecycle readiness and the DONE oracle.

A status=waived delivery promise with no verification claims and a waiverReason of at least 30 characters is accepted as the documented waived positive, while status=unverified remains persisted only as unresolved/blocking and never counts as PASS.

edge.desc: A documented legacy delivery row with missing status is accepted only by the explicit compatibility branch when its legacy fields form a valid positive; the same fields with explicit status=unverified remain blocking and cannot be upgraded by compatibility inference.

A generated envelope matrix mutates every status, verifiedBy, evidence, and waiverReason field individually and pairwise, covering missing, empty, unknown, non-canonical/nonzero, mutually exclusive, and conflicting values with a stable classification for every combination.

adversarial.desc: Contradictions including unverified plus verifiedBy/evidence, waived plus verification claims, met/verified without required claims, unknown status, or waiverReason on a non-waived state fail with delivery_promise_outcome_contradiction before store.writeDeliveryCheck; the delivery artifact and process evidence remain byte-for-byte unwritten.

The public CLI schema and a direct handler invocation independently enforce the same normalized predicate and stable reason code, so bypassing CLI validation cannot persist a contradictory PASS envelope and product-reviewer negative controls cannot self-certify unverified data.

Machine readiness and the DONE oracle consume the shared normalized outcome rather than duplicating field checks; injecting every rejected matrix row or an explicit-unverified legacy-shaped row into persisted input remains blocking in both consumers, while verified/met/waived positives agree.

items.title: Block production test seams from reaching side-effect sinks
items.context: Use B-914f F-011 as regression: an env-derived smoke seam flowed into writeFileSync arbitrary path. Add a bounded static/AST guard over production core/handlers that rejects SMOKE/TEST env switches and env-derived flows into write/rm/rename/exec/spawn sinks; race tests should use temp-repo pure helpers or capability-limited injected callbacks.
items.userSees: The guard prints `Production test seam guard: PASS — no unsafe SMOKE/TEST control reaches a filesystem or process sink.` A negative fixture using env-derived readyFile to writeFileSync is rejected, while ordinary PATH/runtime reads and sanitized bounded numeric/enum controls remain accepted.
excludes: Refactoring done_prepare timeout behavior or its fixed bounded smoke controls

happy.desc: The bounded production scan of packages/main/src/core and packages/main/src/handlers reports PASS after removing the arbitrary validate-lock SMOKE/TEST environment path seam, while task-only test code remains outside the production scan.

The validate lock race is still proven with a temp-repository pure helper or capability-limited injected callback whose targets are fixed by test construction; no CLI argument or environment value can select a filesystem path, executable, or process argument for that capability.

edge.desc: Positive fixtures allow ordinary PATH/runtime environment reads, an envPositiveInt-style bounded numeric sanitizer, and an enum sanitizer that selects only fixed filesystem/process constants; malformed, out-of-range, or unknown values fail or fall back without reaching a dynamic sink.

The AST/data-flow guard follows SMOKE/TEST-named environment values through direct use and one or more simple local assignments, aliases, destructuring, and argument forwarding, and reports a stable source location plus the reached sink.

adversarial.desc: Negative fixtures reject direct and simple-local flows from SMOKE/TEST environment values into filesystem path sinks mkdir/mkdirSync, write/writeFile/writeFileSync, rm/rmSync, and rename/renameSync, including the B-914f readyFile-to-writeFileSync regression.

Negative fixtures reject direct and simple-local environment flows into process executable or argument sinks exec/execSync, execFile/execFileSync, spawn/spawnSync, including separate taint of command, argv, cwd, and shell-enabled inputs.

Attempts to reach the test-only race capability through the public CLI, unknown flags, inherited environment variables, or direct production handler input are rejected before filesystem/process effects; the real lock-order assertion still passes through the capability-limited test harness, proving the capability is test-useful but production-unreachable.
